dataformat.name: toon
dataformat.title: TOON
dataformat.description: Marshal JSON-compatible Java values to TOON (Token-Oriented Object Notation) and unmarshal TOON back to Java objects.
dataformat.label: dataformat,transformation,json

indent.description: Number of spaces per indentation level.

delimiter.description: Delimiter used for tabular array rows and inline primitive arrays.

strict.description: Whether to enable strict validation when unmarshalling TOON. When false, the decoder applies the non-strict recoveries of the TOON specification, such as accepting an array whose length differs from the declared length; other malformed TOON still fails.

contentTypeHeader.description: Whether the data format should set the Content-Type header to text/toon when marshalling.
